visual_prior_specs.name: presentation_design_critique_overlay
visual_prior_specs.content_description: A runtime overlay protocol for slide-making agents that marks visual design issues directly on a draft slide before guiding a cleaner redraw.
visual_prior_specs.visual_rationale: Slide quality depends on spatial hierarchy, spacing, grouping, reading order, and decoration level. Rendering critique directly onto the slide makes these visual constraints actionable for a redraw agent in a way text-only rules do not reliably preserve.
visual_encodings: Red outline = structural issue such as clutter, equal-weight cards, or unclear reading order.
Amber outline = hierarchy or evidence issue.
Purple outline = generic decorative AI styling.
Green guidance box = redraw instruction for the next pass.
Final redraw image = same content with clearer hierarchy and restrained style.
text_exclusions: Business strategy and content edits stay in Markdown text.
Long design critique prose stays outside the overlay.
Subjective taste claims must be framed as style-specific guidance.
forbidden_elements: Brand assets copied from external decks
Opaque marks that hide slide evidence
visual_prior_specs.renderer_description: Render compact critique regions and redraw guidance onto the draft slide image, then use the overlay state to produce a cleaner slide redraw.
renderer_outputs: redraw guidance for the slide generation agent

image_roles: Draft slide image produced by a first-pass or text-only agent.
Dynamic critique overlay rendered onto the draft slide.
Style reference board with reusable visual constraints.
Final redraw image preserving the same slide content.
binding_protocol.coordinate_system: Use slide pixel coordinates for critique bounding boxes; redraw output may use slide layout regions rather than exact copied coordinates.
text_to_visual_binding: Red critique regions bind to structural layout problems.
Amber critique regions bind to weak hierarchy or missing evidence signals.
Purple critique regions bind to decorative AI-style elements.
Green guidance region binds to the next redraw instruction.
Style board binds text guidance to visual examples of hierarchy, spacing, and palette.
task_binding_rules: Preserve the user's required slide content and message.
Inspect visual composition before writing redesign instructions.
Render critique marks on the draft slide before redrawing.
Use the latest critique overlay as visual working memory for the redraw.
Evaluate the redraw against the marked issues rather than against generic taste words.
anti_leakage_rules: Do not copy synthetic slide metrics or topic into user-specific outputs.
Do not import external brand systems or copyrighted deck layouts.
Do not hide the draft slide under large opaque critique marks.
Do not remove required content while improving visual hierarchy.

runtime_protocol.update_rule: At each round, inspect the current slide image, render critique marks for the most important visual issues, convert marks into redraw instructions, and generate or request a revised slide that addresses the visible critique.
runtime_protocol.stop_condition: Stop when the redraw preserves the required content and resolves the high-severity critique regions, or when max_rounds or missing content blocks progress.
runtime_protocol.renderer_spec: Renderer draws translucent critique boxes and compact labels directly on the draft slide. It must keep the slide readable, avoid long prose labels, and produce redraw guidance linked to each marked region.

usage_constraints: This showcase demonstrates one professional PPT style, not universal design taste.
At runtime, render critique marks onto the user's draft slide before redrawing.
Do not invent unsupported slide content or metrics.
Do not copy synthetic content, coordinates, or layout as user-specific output.
Keep critique labels compact and preserve the draft image evidence.
For public-source examples, keep source attribution visible and avoid endorsement claims.
